# `scope_set_beep_volume`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Set the mount beep volume.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build matches (READ)) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0x71080 (64-bit build) |

Calls the mount beep-volume setter, which sends a sound-volume command to the device. Success returns integer 0; whether the volume actually changed is not acknowledged in the reply. Served by the guider process (TCP 4400); a client on the main command port reaches it through the imager unknown-method relay, which is unavailable to guest-table clients. The native-handler grade below does not describe the relay. Mount serial (firmware 9.31, READ): :SBu0, :SBu1 or :SBu2.

Side effects: Sends a sound-volume command to the mount device.

| 101 | Dispatcher: text fails to parse | `invalid JSON request: <reason> on line <n> ...` |
| 103 | Dispatcher: unregistered method | `method not found` |

Further branches forward the error code recorded by the native mount layer; those codes are not exhausted by this table.

## Example

Request, request:

```json
{"id":21,"method":"scope_set_beep_volume","params":1}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"scope_set_beep_volume","result":0,"code":0,"id":21}
```

Reply, err-104:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"scope_set_beep_volume","error":"expected int param","code":104,"id":22}
```
